name: cloudflare-email-service
tagline_zh: 发信被退、收信丢失时，不用再翻五篇文档拼步骤。它按发送/路由两条链路逐段检查。
tagline_en: When mail bounces or goes missing, stop piecing together five docs. It walks both send and route paths, pinning.
desc_en: Implement or troubleshoot Cloudflare Email Sending and Email Routing integrations and their delivery configuration.
why_zh: 把 Email Sending 和 Email Routing 拆成两条独立排查路径。
why_en: Splits Email Sending vs Routing into two independent diagnostic tracks, each checked against live delivery state—not generic.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Cloudflare 自家邮件服务，不修第三方 SMTP 中继。
limit_en: Only Cloudflare-native email services; requires a domain on Cloudflare with DNS access. Stops at config recommendations—won't send test mail or fix.
title_en: Troubleshoot Cloudflare email sending & routing from DNS.
